<noinclude>This page lists the major class-focused set items. Also see: [[All Set Items]]

== Class-Focused Sets ==
Set bonuses are listed separately rather than cumulatively - if multiple bonuses add the same attributes, those bonuses will be added together before taking effect.

<span class="nmod">Set items may be ethereal. They may also be [[Recipes#Upgrading_Recipes|upgraded]].</span>

In addition to the changes listed here, all melee weapons also gain <span class="nmod">Melee Attacks Deal Splash Damage</span>.
</noinclude>
